topic: News breakdown: Jensen Huang steps down as Nvidia CEO, days before earnings
post:
The face of the AI boom just stepped down. 🔌
Here's the breakdown on Nvidia's CEO change, and why it matters beyond one company.

What happened:
Nvidia announced in an SEC filing that Jensen Huang resigned as CEO, effective immediately, after 33 years leading the company.

Who's in charge now:
👤 CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO
🏛️ Harvey C. Jones was named the board's first chair
🔍 A search for a permanent CEO is underway

Why he left:
Nvidia's announcement gave no reason. NBC News and Al Jazeera report it followed reports about his personal relationships, including one that triggered FBI and congressional investigations. Huang later apologized publicly.

What's next:
Nvidia is scheduled to report quarterly results on Nov 17. 📊

Why it matters:
Nvidia's chips power much of the AI industry. When the company most tied to AI changes leaders this suddenly, everyone building on AI is watching. ⚡

Practical takeaway:
If your work depends on one AI vendor, list your backup options. Leadership, prices and roadmaps can change overnight. 📝

What's your take: business as usual at Nvidia, or a turning point? 👇
